svg.title: Local participation in a multi-space server
svg.desc: Local rooms remain in SQLite. Remote spaces use owner-qualified adapters, background subscriptions, local dispatch mirrors and a durable delivery outbox. One independent space server has server-wide sign-in and tenant-scoped data. Server administration does not grant content access.
